_comment: gdd-npc-dialogue.md §10.1 — the request_action eligibility matrix. Data-defined per §5.1/§10.2 (rule 1: every request_action id must exist in this registry; LLM-suggested actions are schema-validated and rejected if unknown). Each row: action_id + a class/role/proficiency PREDICATE (any matching sub-clause qualifies) + the owning-subsystem handoff target + whether payment applies (drives the offer_terms negotiation) + the per-issue framing tone + min_attitude gate (§6.4) + RAW anchor. RequestableActionsMatrix.requestable_actions(npc, profs, flags) evaluates the predicates deterministically. Predicate keys (all optional, OR'd across keys, values are any-of arrays unless noted): progressions (combat_progression in), classes (character_class in), roles (npc_role in), proficiencies (has ANY of), min_level (int, NPC level >=), flag (a context flag that must be true: is_ruler|is_commander|mobile|combat_capable). A row with an empty predicate never matches (defensive).

actions.notes: Arcane/divine caster casts a spell on a party member for a fee. Clerics never cast for opposite alignment; double fee outside their faith (RAW).
Commission contract; duration & cost per magic research rules; completion event scheduled.
Employment as ruffian/henchman first, then hijink assignment per rules; capture consequences owned by the hijink system. The (type) param picks the hijink kind.
Existing specialist-commission path. The (topic) param picks the research subject.
Any mobile NPC, Friendly. Scheduled travel event.
Introduction seeds a new npc_relationships row with a +favor.
Temporary ally: joins the party side for the pending encounter only; NOT a hire. Cowed also qualifies (adjudicated by the attitude gate).
Routes to persuade_ruler (§10.3). The (action_id) param names a RulerActionCatalog action; Seam-B validates it.
Routes to the army-parley demand set (§10.4).
